en.text:
<strand/>Threaded Spike can now target and bounce to <strand/>Tangles, detonating them on impact and immediately returning to the user.

Catching the <strand/>Threaded Spike after it detonates a <strand/>Tangle equips you with a second throwable <strand/>Tangle. Alternatively, failing to catch the <strand/>Threaded Spike triggers a 9 meter <strand/>Strand Detonation around you, dealing <pve 727 /> <pvp [?] /> damage with no falloff. 

This detonation counts as Powered Melee damage, scaling with the Melee stat and triggering melee-effects.

Catching a <strand/>Threaded Spike that didn't detonate a <strand/>Tangle refunds an additional fixed 25% Melee Ability Energy.
